audit.whatIsWrong: Every early row of the chart contradicts its own why-text: content win[] gives Riven levels 2-3 and calls 1, 4-5 and 6 'Skill', while the whys say 'Riven cannot cancel your level-1 Q silence, so you win the first trade', 'your Q lockout still shuts down her Broken Wings', 'you spin E on a silenced Riven who cannot dash away' and 'Even at 6 you can silence-into-R execute her low base health'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Riven, Riven] at a 55.05% Garen win rate. Garen owns everything up to first item because Decisive Strike's silence locks Broken Wings, Ki Burst and Valor for the trade; Riven takes over once Blade of the Exile and her first item are online.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through 6 to Garen 6/10; First item and 2+ items to Riven 4/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry credits Blade of the Exile with a shield twice: 'her R Blade of the Exile range and shield', 'her R shield, extended range'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Blade of the Exile: 'empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.' There is no shield on it — the shield is Valor (E), on 10/9/8/7/6s. Mislabelling which spell carries the shield changes when Garen should commit his burst.
audit.corrected: R gives bonus AD, range and one Wind Slash; the shield-dash is E Valor.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues 0). Broken Wings' timer never appears.
audit.why: Ki Burst is 11/10/9/8/7s (the quoted 11s is right for rank 1), Broken Wings runs on a flat 13s for the full three-cast chain, Valor 10s at rank 1, Blade of the Exile 120/90/60s. Broken Wings' 13s is the real gate on whether she can re-engage after you silence her.
audit.corrected: Both her engage timers stated so the step-up has a clock.

audit.whatIsWrong: Labelled 'Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10, Riven carry threat 8.5/10' while diff is 'FAV', breakdown.carry says 8/10 and Garen wins 55.05%.
audit.why: The rating fields disagree with each other and with the data inside a single entry.
audit.corrected: Favoured matchup, 5.5/10 difficulty, 8/10 carry threat — consistent with diff, breakdown.carry and the win rate.

audit.why: Silence-locked early game for Garen, Riven takes over on items — the early/mid/late prose already names Broken Wings and the silence lockout correctly.

notes: Level chart proposed as one atomic group across both layers; it previously contradicted its own why-text in five of seven rows. Rating trio (diffRating, carryRating, breakdown.difficulty, report[14].t) edited together so the entry no longer calls a 55% lane 'Hard' while its diff token says FAV. Not asserted: whether Garen's Q silence prevents Riven from continuing an already-started Broken Wings chain, or whether Ki Burst's stun can be shortened meaningfully by Courage's tenacity — neither is settled by the kit text, so the page still says only 'silence her before she chains'.
